title: The sign-in gate, offline
persona: Someone opening GreenFolio for the first time on a train with no signal, typing carelessly.
goal: Try to get in: leave fields empty, type an email with no @, a very long email, a short password, tick and untick the terms box, press Sign in each time, open the Terms and Privacy links and come back. The phone is offline; see how the app explains that.
success: Each attempt gets a clear message, being offline is explained rather than shown as a raw error, and the app is still on the sign-in screen.
